items.markdown:
A focus timer `helps you manage your time and maintain concentration by breaking work into deliberate intervals`.[[1]](https://pomodorotimer.online/)

### Popular Online Focus Timers

- [Pomofocus](https://pomofocus.io/) : A clean, customizable online Pomodoro timer with task management and visual reports.[[1]](https://pomofocus.io/)
- [Flocus](https://flocus.com/) : An aesthetic workspace tool featuring a focus timer, ambient soundscapes, and to-do lists.[[1]](https://flocus.com/)
- [Forest App](https://forestapp.cc/) : A gamified timer that lets you grow virtual trees while staying off your phone.[[1]](https://forestapp.cc/)

### The Pomodoro Technique Basics

- **Pick a task:** Choose one single thing to work on.
- **Focus for 25 minutes:** Work with no tabs, notifications, or distractions.
- **Take a 5-minute break:** Step away, stretch, or grab water.
- **Repeat:** After four work blocks, take a longer break of 15 to 30 minutes.[[1]](https://studiestimer.com/)[[2]](https://pomodorotimer.online/)[[3]](https://www.morgen.so/pomodoro-timer)
